name: lint-uz-suite
description: Suite of client-side format viewers under lint.uz

scripts.deploy:site: node build.mjs site && cd site && npx wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:json: node build.mjs json && cd json && npx wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:xml: node build.mjs xml && cd xml && npx wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:yaml: node build.mjs yaml && cd yaml && npx wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:csv: node build.mjs csv && cd csv && npx wrangler deploy
scripts.dev:site: node build.mjs site && cd site && npx wrangler dev
scripts.dev:json: node build.mjs json && cd json && npx wrangler dev
scripts.dev:xml: node build.mjs xml && cd xml && npx wrangler dev
scripts.dev:yaml: node build.mjs yaml && cd yaml && npx wrangler dev
scripts.dev:csv: node build.mjs csv && cd csv && npx wrangler dev
